タイトル: JustCall Review: A Comprehensive and User-Friendly Communication Platform
投稿者: Aman インドのResearcher 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 化学, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "JustCall Review: A Comprehensive and User-Friendly Communication Platform"
良い点: JustCall is a highly favored communication platform for businesses due to its user-friendly interface, advanced call management functionalities, seamless integration with various business tools, and exceptional customer support. These features have been highly appreciated by users and contribute to the popularity of the platform.
改善点: I have experienced occasional technical issues and malfunctions with JustCall, which can cause inconvenience during usage. Additionally, a few users have expressed concerns about the platform's pricing plans, which they find to be relatively expensive for small businesses. However, it should be noted that these issues are not universal and may vary based on individual user requirements and experiences.

タイトル: Excellent solution and excellent customer support
投稿者: Stefano カナダのVP Operations 小売, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Excellent solution and excellent customer support"
良い点: Justcall integrates incredibly well with a large amount of other Saas. Their ability to thread Callcs, voicemail, SMS in a single conversation within several different CRMs is something that (incredibly?) remains something very unique. Most other solutions do voice but not texts and if they do texts it is only through their own dialer but info doesn't flow to the core Saas that originate the communication. With Justcall we have the ability to see all conversation regaridng of medium in a single place, be it a candidate conversation in our ATS or a support interaction in our CRM/ticketing system. It works and it work well.
改善点: They seem to be moving to new plans that include unlimited calls but for our user case that is not the best. I have relatively many users for a relatively low traffic so I prefer to keep paying phone traffic separately. Not an issue for us as we remain in the old plan, but something to assess. Most other solutions in the market beside Twilio will likely also have an unlimited calls options by the way.

タイトル: Not for a fit for new, small, or start up businesses
投稿者: Craig アメリカのOwner 経理, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Not for a fit for new, small, or start up businesses"
良い点: The ability to do CRM like actions within the system and do SMS messaging. Itlooked like it an application that would provide what needed currently, as well as the type of features that we wanted to grow into.
改善点: My business partner and did three video calls with Just call to discuss and review the application, see if it would work our needs and learn how to use it. We must have spent in total a bit more than a half of a day's work so that we could review that the application would solve our problems and learn how to use it to do so. Well, not long into our trial, they sent us this message: We are writing to inform you that your JustCall account has been permanently closed. Our systems has detected usage linked to your JustCall account that violates our Terms and Conditions. As a result, your JustCall account has been closed, and you will not have any access to our services. Please note that this decision is final. If you believe this action was taken in error, you may contact us at [email protected] to reconsider our action. Well,it was a pretty nasty message of itself, but we figured we would give justcall a chance to explain themselves and fix it. I explained to them that I was in the process of transitioning from one business service to a similar one, had reserved my domain name but the new web site is currently in development. We need a phone number to put on our new website for our new business before we can plop the web site down on the domain. I explained that to them, but apparently that wasn't good enough, and they told us to move on.

投稿者: Sergio パナマのIT Manager マーケティング、広告, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Loving the SMS Experience"

Managing client communications can be time-consuming, but with Justcall, we've streamlined the entire process. The automation features have not only increased our efficiency but also allowed us to maintain a personal touch in every message. From scheduling follow-ups to handling bulk messages, Justcall has given us the flexibility to customize and optimize our communication strategy. The platform is intuitive and offers a range of features that cater to our specific needs. Plus, the analytics have been invaluable in helping us fine-tune our approach and maximize engagement.
改善点: One thing that’s a bit of a pain for us at HIE is trying to locate specific SMS messages. 😅 With so many people writing in, it can feel like finding a needle in a haystack! We love the automation Justcall provides, but when it comes to searching for a message, it’s a bit of a hassle—especially when you're juggling a ton of conversations. It’s like scrolling through an endless sea of texts! A more streamlined search feature would make a world of difference for us.

投稿者: Kyra アメリカのCustomer Success 消費者サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "A Versatile Service"
良い点: JustCall has a wide range of functionality. Their name is a misnomer because they do so much more than "just call". The features we use the most are calling, call transferring, texting, and texting campaigns. JustCall integrates so nicely with Hubspot, which is a literal lifesaver for our team. You can also create saved text templates so you don't have to type out the same message if you're sending it multiple times a day. JustCall's support team is relatively responsive (chatbot on site) and can usually accommodate special requests for new features or modifications of current ones. This has been really nice for our team.
改善点: JustCall's support team is based in India, and the language barrier can occasionally become an issue. Sometimes calls drop, the interface isn't super appealing, and the Chrome extension that allows you to easily text or call often has issues. Using the same account with more than one user is difficult at times, as notifications will only go to one user, and the notifications don't always update automatically so you have to refresh manually a lot.
